address: Shop 102, 1F, Metro South Tower 2, 39 Wong Chuk Hang Road, Wong Chuk Hang, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: With custom-made crockery and retro marquetry on the walls and tables, the space feels stylish and spacious. Noodles and buns are handmade à la minute in the glass-clad kitchen, so expect a wait during peak hours. Try their noodles in gentle scallion oil – bouncy noodles dressed in the perfect amount of infused oil. The xiao long bao are also exquisitely made with beautiful pleats and soupy pork filling. The combo sets are great value....
